trello.name: Document Security Incident: Support Ticket Injection Attempt
trello.desc: Owner: Hassan. Deadline: This week. Task: Create a formal incident write-up for the support ticket injection attempt. Include the raw ticket content, a record of what the summarizer actually produced (garbled output with 'URGENT'), timestamps, and a severity assessment. File this in the security log.

trello.name: Harden Ticket Pipeline Against Prompt Injection
trello.desc: Owner: Wren. Task: Implement hardening measures for the ticket pipeline. Specifically: 1) Add a sanitization layer in the ticket parser to delimit quoted customer content and treat it as data. 2) Implement an instruction-pattern filter to strip or neutralize instruction-like content. 3) Create a regression test using the specific injection ticket to ensure the summary remains clean. 4) Add an evaluation suite that runs small injection attempts against the summarizer on every deploy.

trello.name: Investigate Password Reset Email Delivery Issues
trello.desc: Owner: Wren. Task: Investigate the underlying issue in the injection ticket regarding password reset emails not arriving. Check reset email delivery logs for the last week. Verify if the account 'jdoe443' is real or a burner. If the account is a burner, close it. If reset emails are genuinely broken for users, escalate this into its own incident.

trello.name: Provide List of New Service Accounts for Quarterly Access Review
trello.desc: Owner: Hassan. Deadline: Thursday. Task: Generate and provide Grace with the list of all service accounts created since May. This is required input for the quarterly access review which is due on Friday.
